# The New Paris Podcast

> An interview podcast by author and journalist Lindsey Tramuta, exploring the people, places, and ideas changing and shaping Paris. Hosted since 2017.

## Host

- [About Lindsey Tramuta](https://thenewparis.com/about.html): French-American journalist and author based in Paris since 2006, author of *The New Paris*, *The New Parisienne*, *The Eater Guide to Paris*, and co-author of *Arbiters of Style*.
